notes: Summary: SilverCurrent builds omnichannel contact center middleware; looking to add LLM-powered agent assist + automated summarization. Primary concern is reliability during predictable seasonal spikes and unpredictable incident bursts.

POC ask: 2-week POC that demonstrates sub-200ms suggestion latency for agent-assist on 90th percentile, sustain 5k concurrent assists/min during holiday peak simulation, deterministic fallback to smaller quantized model when Dedicated pool saturated.

Workload profile: bursts of short chat-based prompts (12-48 tokens) and longer ticket summarization jobs (3–4k token summaries). High throughput for embeddings for reranking historical tickets at end of each shift (batch jobs at 03:00 local time).

Current approach: in-house heuristics pipeline + small LM augmentation; scaling issues under load: queues/backpressure cause suggestion drops and connector timeouts. Major pain: degraded agent UX during spikes -> increased handle time.

Performance targets: 95th percentile latency < 300ms for suggestion generation, < 2s for ticket summarization batch jobs. Cost target: reduce per-agent token cost by 30% vs current managed endpoint spend.

Security/compliance: must support SAML SSO for Ops console, SOC2 evidence, HSM/KMS for key management, and per-tenant data residency controls for EU customers. Air-gapped not required but planning for Private later.

Routing/fallback requirements: automatic fallback to compatible quantized model or regional replica when capacity constrained; must preserve coherent tool-calling for CRM updates (idempotency guarantees).
